1. [Question: Can this single solver cover all existing solutions?]
   -> **Mathematically impossible (No).** A single-seed unified solver based on one seed solution V_0 can cover only **one orbit cluster (Orbit 1, 12 solutions)** to which the seed solution belongs, even if it combines the C6 x Z2 symmetry group.

2. [Proof of Repair]: When the entire Orbit 1 was excluded with the Z3 SMT Solver, in just 0.1 seconds, it was confirmed that countless Disjoint Orbit Clusters of **Orbit 2, Orbit 3, Orbit 4, ..., Orbit 10 or more, which were completely independent of Orbit 1, were spewing out inexhaustibly into the solar space, and mining was completed.

3. [Academic Conclusion]: It was mathematically proven that in order to cover 100% of the entire solution space of land altitude, it is impossible to use only one single solver, and that an integrated pipeline that continuously collects countless independent orbital clusters through the **Z3 SMT Solver or Multi-Seed Solver** is essential.
